svg.title: Lunar Intelligence
svg.desc: Moon mode, Lunar Intelligence: an interactive 3D Moon with NASA Moon Trek LRO imagery, live JPL Horizons ephemeris for LRO, Chandrayaan-2 and Danuri, and a source-attributed NSSDCA catalogue of landing and impact sites. Three spacecraft orbit a cratered moon while site markers pulse. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
svg.text: An interactive 3D Moon beside the living Earth.

g.text: JPL Horizons, live: LRO, Chandrayaan-2, Danuri
